results.summary: Java 21 coding standards review failed for backend. Critical placeholder/sample artifacts remain in src/main, and there are additional High issues around package/version standard alignment, missing service interfaces, and ambiguous nullable contracts.

findings.title: Placeholder/sample artifacts remain in production source and seed data
findings.description: The standards prohibit placeholder/sample/dummy artifacts in src/main unless seed data is explicitly justified. Production DTO documentation calls the price a sample price and the image URL a placeholder, and the production Flyway seed migration stores placeholder image paths for products without an explanatory exemption.
findings.evidence: ProductDto.java:15 `@param price JPY sample price`; ProductDto.java:17 `@param imageUrl optional placeholder image URL`; V2__seed_products.sql:2 starts repeated `/images/products/*-placeholder.png` values through the seed migration.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace placeholder/sample wording and image paths with real OSS-safe product asset URLs, or add an explicit seed-data rationale and make the DTO describe the actual contract rather than placeholder behavior.

findings.title: Spring Boot version does not match the 3.2.x review baseline
findings.description: The agent standard is Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.2.x, but the backend parent is Spring Boot 3.5.8. This is a project-wide standards deviation and may invalidate assumptions about APIs and behavior for the migration baseline.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the parent to the approved Spring Boot 3.2.x line, or explicitly update the governing standard and compatibility expectations if 3.5.x is intentional.

findings.title: Base package does not match required com.skishop namespace
findings.description: The review standard states the migration base package is `com.skishop`, but production Java packages and Maven groupId use `com.codexskishop`. Package naming is a High-severity standards item.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename packages and Maven groupId to the required `com.skishop` namespace, or record an approved standards exception if `com.codexskishop` is the intended OSS namespace.

findings.title: DI-managed service classes do not define corresponding interfaces
findings.description: The DI checklist requires all Service / Repository classes to have corresponding interfaces. Repositories are interfaces, but multiple `@Service` classes are concrete-only and are injected by concrete type, reducing consistency and substitutability.
findings.evidence: Concrete-only services include ProductQueryService.java:18, AdminAuthService.java:26, ProductSearchService.java:19, ZeroHitRecordingService.java:25, AiConsultationService.java:19, and ZeroHitQueryService.java:23.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce focused service interfaces such as `ProductQueryUseCase`, `ProductSearchUseCase`, `AdminAuthUseCase`, and inject those interfaces at controller/filter boundaries while keeping implementations package-consistent.

findings.title: Nullable public contracts are handled implicitly without nullability annotations
findings.description: Several public service/helper methods accept null and branch on it, but parameters are not annotated with `@Nullable` or `@NonNull`. The null-safety checklist requires annotations where ambiguity exists.
findings.evidence: `toPageable(Integer limit, String sort)` handles nullable values; `normalizeCategories(String category)` line 58 handles null; `ProductQueryService.listProducts(...)` line 37 and `ProductSearchService.search(...)` line 44 pass nullable request values; `KeywordNormalizer.normalize(String keyword)` line 19 accepts null.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit nullability annotations to nullable parameters, preferably at the boundary and helper methods, and use non-null annotations for required parameters/returns where ambiguity remains.

findings.title: Boolean DTO components do not use is/has/can/should prefixes
findings.description: Boolean fields/accessors should use `is/has/can/should` prefixes. Record components generate accessors named after the component, so `success()`, `authenticated()`, and `zeroHitRecorded()` do not follow the boolean naming rule.
findings.evidence: LoginResponse.java:10 `boolean success`; AuthMeResponse.java:9 `boolean authenticated`; ProductSearchResponse.java:12 `boolean zeroHitRecorded`.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename to boolean components such as `isSuccess`, `isAuthenticated`, and `hasZeroHitRecorded` or document an API-contract exception and update frontend/tests together if renamed.

escalations.description: Decide whether `com.codexskishop` and Spring Boot 3.5.8 are intentional project standards changes or must be realigned to the agent baseline (`com.skishop`, Spring Boot 3.2.x).
Decide whether product seed data is acceptable as demo seed data with explicit documentation, or whether placeholder image paths must be replaced with real OSS-safe assets before release.

results.rawMarkdown:
# Source Code Review Report: Java 21 Coding Standards Review

## Summary
- **Review Target**: backend
- **Verdict**: ❌ Fail
- **Issue Count**: Critical: 1 / High: 4 / Medium: 1 / Low: 0

## Prohibited Pattern Detection Results
| # | Pattern | Count | Target File | Line # |
|---|---------|-------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | Placeholder/sample artifacts in src/main | 2 Java comment hits plus repeated SQL seed values | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/ProductDto.java`; `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_products.sql` | 15, 17, 2 |

No evidence found for `System.out.println`, `System.err.println`, `printStackTrace()`, empty `catch (Exception)`, direct `new RestTemplate()`, `Thread.sleep()`, field injection, `UnsupportedOperationException`, collection `return null`, raw collection declarations, or unsafe `Optional.get()` in the reviewed Java sources.

## Incomplete / Shortcut Implementation Detection Results
| # | Type | Detection | Target File | Line # | Details |
|---|------|-----------|-------------|--------|---------|
| 1 | Placeholder/sample production artifact | `sample price`, `placeholder image URL`, repeated `*-placeholder.png` seed image paths | `ProductDto.java`; `V2__seed_products.sql` | 15, 17, 2 | Production API/seed data still carries placeholder semantics without an explicit seed-data exemption. |

## Naming Convention Check Results
| File | Violation Location | Current Name | Recommended Name |
|------|-------------------|-------------|------------------|
| `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/BackendApplication.java` | package declaration | `com.codexskishop` | `com.skishop` per review baseline, unless exception approved |
| `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/LoginResponse.java` | record component | `success` | `isSuccess` |
| `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/AuthMeResponse.java` | record component | `authenticated` | `isAuthenticated` |
| `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/ProductSearchResponse.java` | record component | `zeroHitRecorded` | `hasZeroHitRecorded` |

## Issues
| # | Severity | Category | Target File | Line # | Issue Description | Fix Example |
|---|----------|----------|-------------|--------|-------------------|-------------|
| 1 | Critical | Incomplete / Shortcut Implementation | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/ProductDto.java` | 15 | Production source says `JPY sample price`; seed data also uses placeholder image paths. | Replace with real contract wording/assets or add explicit seed-data rationale. |
| 2 | High | Spring Boot Standard | `backend/pom.xml` | 8 | Parent version is Spring Boot 3.5.8, not the 3.2.x baseline. | Align to approved 3.2.x or update the governing standard. |
| 3 | High | Naming Conventions | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/BackendApplication.java` | 1 | Package root is `com.codexskishop`, not `com.skishop`. | Rename package/groupId or approve a standards exception. |
| 4 | High | DI Pattern Quality | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/service/ProductQueryService.java` | 18 | Concrete-only services lack corresponding interfaces. | Define use-case interfaces and inject through them. |
| 5 | High | Null Safety | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/service/ProductRequestOptions.java` | 28 | Nullable parameters are accepted without nullability annotations. | Add `@Nullable` / non-null annotations consistently. |
| 6 | Medium | Naming Conventions | `backend/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/dto/LoginResponse.java` | 10 | Boolean record components do not use required boolean prefixes. | Rename to `isSuccess`, `isAuthenticated`, `hasZeroHitRecorded`, with API/test updates. |

## Scorecard
| Evaluation Item | Score (1-5) | Notes |
|----------------|-------------|-------|
| Naming Conventions | 2/5 | Package baseline mismatch and boolean DTO naming violations. |
| Java 21 Feature Adoption | 4/5 | Records, switch expressions, and text blocks are used appropriately; no major legacy Java syntax found. |
| Prohibited Pattern Compliance | 1/5 | Critical placeholder/sample artifacts remain in src/main. |
| DI Pattern Quality | 3/5 | Constructor injection and final fields are good, but service interfaces are missing. |
| Null Safety | 3/5 | Optional returns and empty collections are generally good, but nullable contracts are not annotated. |
| **Total Score** | **13/25** | Fail due to Critical finding. |

## Escalation Items (Requires Human Judgment)
- Confirm whether `com.codexskishop` and Spring Boot 3.5.8 are approved deviations from the stated baseline.
- Confirm whether placeholder product image seed data is acceptable for OSS demo release or must be replaced before publication.
